limited_verification: Retained scientific source identity and earlier bounded checks are preserved. The covariance environment passed fresh dependency/import, synthetic I/O and frozen-aggregate checks without fitting. The explicit-Array ICD entry passed 12 synthetic tests and a full read-only comparison of 502163 participants / 7071243 existing rows, including diagnosis descriptions and dates. No formal input rebuild or new scientific fitting was performed; full-study reconstruction was not rerun.

UKB-RAP download/extraction, independent reconstruction of the full 78-slot phenotype export, and a fresh clean-environment end-to-end rebuild were not performed. Original-cohort provenance/hash gates remain active.
